input: # Rows for the reader defects reported as GitHub issues, grouped by issue.
# Expected values are the YAML 1.2 reading; js-yaml and the yaml package agree on every row.
# tabnas/yaml#90: a digit-first plain scalar with a colon runs to the end of the line
# tabnas/yaml#89: a bracket or quote inside a scalar or comment is text, not flow syntax
# tabnas/yaml#88: a flow sequence first in an indented block sequence is an item
# tabnas/yaml#86: a quoted key at column 0 after a block sequence is the next key
# found by the yaml-test-schema corpus: a signed digit-first scalar, and a digit-first scalar with a colon in flow
# tabnas/yaml#95: a `#` straight after a leading number is part of the scalar, since
# YAML starts a comment only at a `#` after white space
